verdict.rationale: The clearest bulk-style capability is Warehouse Sync, which ingests large datasets from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks into mParticle through a documented API, SQL reference and data mapping. Audience features also act on whole user populations at once, such as activating cohorts and suppressing households. The evidence does not show general bulk operations on platform items, such as batch-editing audiences, applying rules to many records, or bulk deletion through an API, so this is only a partial, indirect fit. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch APIs for managing many items at once, batch-edit or bulk-delete operations, AI-driven bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
